bio.text: Claudia Tenney was first elected to the U.S. House of Representatives on November 8, 2016, and was elected again in November 2020; she serves on the Ways and Means Committee.
She served in the New York State Assembly, first elected in 2010.
She is an attorney and was co-owner and legal counsel of Mid-York Press, Inc., and founded Tenney Media Group in 1997.
She graduated from Colgate University and the University of Cincinnati College of Law.
